key_claims.claim: Contrast-enhanced mammography and abbreviated MRI are being compared head-to-head as supplemental screening modalities for extremely dense breasts within a randomized trial embedded in the Dutch national program.
An AI system for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer on MRI achieved radiologist-level agreement across more than 22,000 exams in diagnostic and screening populations globally.
A contrast-enhanced ultrasound feature termed perfusion beyond margin independently predicts recurrence and local progression in hepatocellular carcinoma and correlates with tumor invasiveness.

Transparency features such as confidence scores and explanations do not improve clinicians' trust calibration in AI diagnostic support; AI recommendations still shifted diagnoses 46 percent of the time.
MOLLI and ShMOLLI T1 mapping sequences yield distinct reference ranges at 3 Tesla across 13 cardiovascular conditions in a large Chinese cohort.
